heading.en: Amalickiah incites the Lamanites against the Nephites—Moroni prepares his people to defend the cause of the Christians—He rejoices in liberty and freedom and is a mighty man of God. About 72 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua faaoso e Amalekia sa Lamanā e faasaga ia sa Nifaē—Ua saunia e Moronae ona tagata e puipui le faamoemoe o tagata Kerisiano—Ua olioli o ia i le filifiliga saoloto ma le saolotoga ma o ia o se tagata malosi o le Atua. E tusa o le 72 T.L.M.

verses.en: And now it came to pass that, as soon as Amalickiah had obtained the kingdom he began to inspire the hearts of the Lamanites against the people of Nephi; yea, he did appoint men to speak unto the Lamanites from their towers, against the Nephites.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo ina ua vave lava ona maua e Amalekia o le malo, na amata ai e ia ona musuia loto o sa Lamanā e faasaga i tagata o Nifae; ioe, sa ia tofia tagata e tautatala atu i sa Lamanā mai i o latou olo, e faasaga ia sa Nifaē.

verses.en: And thus he did inspire their hearts against the Nephites, insomuch that in the latter end of the nineteenth year of the reign of the judges, he having accomplished his designs thus far, yea, having been made king over the Lamanites, he sought also to reign over all the land, yea, and all the people who were in the land, the Nephites as well as the Lamanites.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona ia musuia o latou loto e faasaga ia sa Nifaē, sa oo ina ia saili foi i le taufaasiusiuga o le lona sefulu ma le iva o tausaga o le nofoaiga a faamasino, ina ua ia faataunuuina lea o ana fuafuaga e oo mai i le taimi lea, ioe, ina ua avea o ia ma tupu o sa Lamanā, na ia taumafai foi e nofotupu i luga o le laueleele atoa, ioe, ma tagata uma lava sa i ai i le laueleele, o sa Nifaē atoa foi ma sa Lamanā.

w.en: of the reign of the judges,

verses.en: Therefore he had accomplished his design, for he had hardened the hearts of the Lamanites and blinded their minds, and stirred them up to anger, insomuch that he had gathered together a numerous host to go to battle against the Nephites.
verses.sm: O lea sa ia faataunuuina ai lana fuafuaga, ona sa ia faamaaa loto o sa Lamanā ma faatauaso o latou mafaufau, ma faaoso le ita ia te i latou, sa oo ina ia faapotopoto se autau e toatele e o atu e tau faasaga ia sa Nifaē.

verses.en: For he was determined, because of the greatness of the number of his people, to overpower the Nephites and to bring them into bondage.
verses.sm: Ona sa naunau o ia, ona o le toatele o le aofai o ona tagata, e faatoilalo sa Nifaē ma aumai i latou i le pologa.

verses.en: And thus he did appoint chief captains of the Zoramites, they being the most acquainted with the strength of the Nephites, and their places of resort, and the weakest parts of their cities; therefore he appointed them to be chief captains over his armies.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona ia tofia o kapeteni sili o lo sa Soramā, ona sa sili atu ona latou iloa le malosi o sa Nifaē, ma o latou nofoaga malu puipuia, ma vaega sili ona vaivai o o latou aai; o lea na ia tofia ai i latou e avea ma kapeteni sili i ana autau.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they took their camp, and moved forth toward the land of Zarahemla in the wilderness.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou ave la latou tolauapiga, ma agai atu i le laueleele o Sara’emila i le vao.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: Now it came to pass that while Amalickiah had thus been obtaining power by fraud and deceit, Moroni, on the other hand, had been preparing the minds of the people to be faithful unto the Lord their God.
verses.sm: O lenei sa oo ina faapea a o maua e Amalekia le pule e ala i le pepelo ma le taufaasese, o Moronae, i le isi itu, sa sauniunia mafaufau o tagata ia faamaoni i le Alii lo latou Atua.

verses.en: Yea, he had been strengthening the armies of the Nephites, and erecting small forts, or places of resort; throwing up banks of earth round about to enclose his armies, and also building walls of stone to encircle them about, round about their cities and the borders of their lands; yea, all round about the land.
verses.sm: Ioe, sa ia faamalosia autau a sa Nifaē, ma faatutū ni olo laiti, po o ni nofoaga malu puipuia; ma ati i luga faupuega eleele faataamilo e puipui ai i totonu ana autau, ma ati foi pa maa e si’o faataamilo ai i latou, e faataamilo i o latou aai ma tuaoi o o latou laueleele; ioe, e faataamilo i le laueleele atoa.

verses.en: And in their weakest fortifications he did place the greater number of men; and thus he did fortify and strengthen the land which was possessed by the Nephites.
verses.sm: Ma i o latou ’olotu’i sa sili ona vaivai sa ia tuu ai le toatele o tane; ma sa faapea ona ia tu’iolo ma faamalosia le laueleele lea sa maua e sa Nifaē.

verses.en: And thus he was preparing to support their liberty, their lands, their wives, and their children, and their peace, and that they might live unto the Lord their God, and that they might maintain that which was called by their enemies the cause of Christians.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona ia sauniuni e lagolago lo latou saolotoga, o latou laueleele, a latou avā, ma a latou fanau, ma lo latou filemu, ma ina ia mafai ona latou ola mo le Alii lo latou Atua, ma ina ia mafai ona latou faatumauina o le mea ua ta’ua e o latou fili o le faamoemoe o le Au Kerisiano.

verses.en: And Moroni was a strong and a mighty man; he was a man of a perfect under– standing; yea, a man that did not delight in bloodshed; a man whose soul did joy in the liberty and the freedom of his country, and his brethren from bondage and slavery;
verses.sm: Ma o Moronae o se tagata malosi ma ta’uta’ua tele; o ia o se tagata ua atoatoa le malamalama; ioe, o se tagata sa le fiafia i le faamasaa toto; o se tagata sa olioli lona agaga i le filifiliga saoloto ma le saolotoga o lona atunuu, ma ona uso mai i le pologa ma le faapologaina;

verses.en: Yea, a man whose heart did swell with thanksgiving to his God, for the many privileges and blessings which he bestowed upon his people; a man who did labor exceedingly for the welfare and safety of his people.
verses.sm: Ioe, o se tagata sa tumu lona loto i le faafetai i lona Atua, mo avanoa ma faamanuiaga e tele na ia faaee mai i luga o lona nuu; o se tagata sa galue malosi lava mo le manuia ma le saogalemu o ona tagata.

verses.en: Yea, and he was a man who was firm in the faith of Christ, and he had sworn with an oath to defend his people, his rights, and his country, and his religion, even to the loss of his blood.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma o ia o se tagata sa mausali i le faatuatua ia Keriso, ma sa tauto o ia i se tautoga e puipui i ona tagata, ana aia, ma lona atunuu, ma lana tapuaiga, e oo lava i le faamaligiina ai o lona toto.

verses.en: Now the Nephites were taught to defend themselves against their enemies, even to the shedding of blood if it were necessary; yea, and  they were also taught never to give an offense, yea, and never to raise the sword except it were against an enemy, except it were to preserve their lives.
verses.sm: O lenei sa a’oa’oina sa Nifaē e puipui i latou lava e faasaga i o latou fili, e oo lava i le faamasaaina o le toto pe afai e tatau ai; ioe, ma sa a’oa’oina foi i latou e aua lava ne’i faia se faatupu vevesi ioe, ma aua lava ne’i siitia le pelu vagana ai e tetee faasaga atu ai i se fili, vagana ai ua mo le faasaoina o o latou ola.

w.en: it be for the preserving of

verses.en: And this was their faith, that by so doing God would prosper them in the land, or in other words, if they were faithful in keeping the commandments of God that he would prosper them in the land; yea, warn them to flee, or to prepare for war, according to their danger;
verses.sm: Ma o lo latou faatuatuaga lenei, e faapea o lo latou faia faapea o le a faamanuia ai i latou e le Atua i le laueleele, pe faapea, afai latou te faamaoni i le tausiga o poloaiga a le Atua o le a ia faamanuiaina i latou i le laueleele; ioe, lapatai i latou ia sosola ese, pe ia saunia mo le taua, e tusa ma lo latou puipuiga;

verses.en: And also, that God would make it known unto them whither they should go to defend themselves against their enemies, and by so doing, the Lord would deliver them; and this was the faith of Moroni, and his heart did glory in it; not in the shedding of blood but in doing good, in preserving his people, yea, in keeping the commandments of God, yea, and resisting iniquity.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, o le a faailoa mai e le Atua ia te i latou le mea latou te o i ai e puipui ai i latou e faasaga i o latou fili, ma o lo latou faia faapea, o le a laveai ai i latou e le Alii; ma o le faatuatuaga lenei o Moronae, ma sa olioli i ai lona loto i lea mea; e lē i le faamasaaina o le toto ae i le faia o mea lelei, i le faasaoina o ona tagata, ioe, i le tausia o poloaiga a le Atua, ioe, ma le tetee atu i le amioletonu.

verses.en: Yea, verily, verily I say unto you, if all men had been, and were, and ever would be, like unto Moroni, behold, the very powers of hell would have been shaken forever; yea, the devil would never have power over the hearts of the children of men.
verses.sm: Ioe, e moni, e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, a na pei tagata uma sa i ai, ma o lo o i ai, ma o le a i ai pea, e faapei o Moronae, faauta, po ua luluina lava mana o seoli e faavavau; ioe, po ua leai lava se mana o le tiapolo i luga o loto o le fanauga a tagata.

verses.en: Behold, he was a man like unto Ammon, the son of Mosiah, yea, and even the other sons of Mosiah, yea, and also Alma and his sons, for they were all men of God.
verses.sm: Faauta, o ia o se tagata sa pei o Amona, le atalii o Mosaea, ioe, ma isi foi atalii o Mosaea, ioe, ma Alema foi ma ona atalii, ona o i latou uma o ni tagata o le Atua.

verses.en: Now behold, Helaman and his brethren were no less serviceable unto the people than was Moroni; for they did preach the word of God, and they did baptize unto repentance all men whosoever would hearken unto their words.
verses.sm: O lenei faauta, sa le itiiti foi le auaunaga a Helamana ma ona uso i le nuu nai lo Moronae; ona sa latou tala’i atu le afioga a le Atua, ma sa latou papatiso i le salamo tagata uma o soo se tasi sa fia faalogo ia latou upu.

verses.en: And thus they went forth, and the people did humble themselves because of their words, insomuch that they were highly favored of the Lord, and thus they were free from wars and contentions among themselves, yea, even for the space of four years.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona latou o atu, ma sa faalotomaualaloina e tagata i latou lava ona o a latou upu, sa oo ina alofagia tele ai i latou e le Alii, ma sa faapea ona tuusaoloto ai i latou mai taua ma finauga i totonu o i latou lava, ioe, mo le va lava o le fa tausaga.

verses.en: But, as I have said, in the latter end of the nineteenth year, yea, notwithstanding their peace amongst themselves, they were compelled reluctantly to contend with their brethren, the Lamanites.
verses.sm: Peitai, e pei ona ou fai atu, o le taufaaiuiuga o le lona sefulu ma le iva o tausaga, ioe, e ui lava i lo latou filemu i totonu o i latou lava, sa faamalosia toa’i i latou e tau ma o latou uso, o sa Lamanā.

verses.en: Yea, and in fine, their wars never did cease for the space of many years with the Lamanites, notwithstanding their much reluctance.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma i se aotelega, sa le taofia lava a latou taua ma sa Lamanā mo le va o le tele o tausaga, e ui i lo latou mumusu tele.

verses.en: Now, they were sorry to take up arms against the Lamanites, because they did not delight in the shedding of blood; yea, and this was not all—they were sorry to be the means of sending so many of their brethren out of this world into an eternal world, unprepared to meet their God.
verses.sm: O lenei, sa latou faanoanoa e siitia a’e auupega e faasaga ia sa Lamanā, ona sa latou le fiafia i le faamasaaina o le toto; ioe, ma sa le ona pau lea— sa latou faanoanoa i le avea ma auala e auina atu ai i fafo le toatele o o latou uso mai lenei lalolagi i se lalolagi faavavau, ua le’i sauni e fetaiai ma lo latou Atua.

w.en: and it was not the only

verses.en: Nevertheless, they could not suffer to lay down their lives, that their wives and their children should be massacred by the barbarous cruelty of those who were once their brethren, yea, and had dissented from their church, and  had left them and had gone to destroy them by joining the Lamanites.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, sa le mafai ona latou tuu atu o latou ola, ina ia fasiotia a latou avā ma a latou fanau e le saua faapaupau o i latou o e sa avea muamua ma o latou uso, ioe, ma ua faatu’iese mai i la latou ekalesia, ma ua latou tuua i latou ma ua o atu e faaumatia i latou i le auai faatasi ma sa Lamanā.

verses.en: Yea, they could not bear that their brethren should rejoice over the blood of the Nephites, so long as there were any who should keep the commandments of God, for the promise of the Lord was, if they should keep his commandments they should prosper in the land.
verses.sm: Ioe, sa le mafai ona latou talitalia ia fiafia o latou uso i luga o le toto o sa Nifaē, pe a i ai lava ni isi o e e tausia poloaiga a le Atua, ona o le folafolaga a le Alii e faapea, afai latou te tausia ana poloaiga o le a latou manuia i le laueleele.
